systems.system: Plataforma de Gestão Integrada da Identificação Civil e Criminal
systems.country_label: Plataforma de Gestão Integrada da Identificação Civil e Criminal
systems.platform: Supplied by China National Electronics Import & Export Corporation (CEIEC)
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos; contract of US$243m authorised by presidential order of January 2017, to be placed on a Chinese commercial credit line
systems.tiers: To be implemented (January 2017); covers birth and death registration, identity-card issuance and the criminal record. 96 identity-card registration and issuing posts existed, 36 of them in Luanda

note: A civil and criminal identification platform of the justice ministry: criminal records, not police station records. Nothing on the police.
